full_judgment: 6. The above definition of the word "Teacher" in the said Rules plainly means only those full-time teachers of a Nationalised High School who were appointed as teachers in the said school before the imposition of embargo on appointment by the Director-General (Respondent No. 4). The said Rules provide the procedure for absorption and are, therefore, applicable only to those teachers who have been absorbed by the Government through the Director-General as teachers of nationalised High Schools. The Rules do not create any right for a teacher to be absorbed as a teacher of a school which is nationalised. Therefore, the petitioner cannot rely on the definition of the word 'teacher' for claiming to be absorbed as Assistant Teacher (Science) of Goalundo Shahid Smrity Girls High School as absorption as teacher is dependent on imposition of embargo on appointment as teacher as put by the Director-General and for appointment as teacher after the date of embargo the approval of the Director-General as he is to take into consideration the financial limitation and several other reasonable factors.
